requirements: R14 native-parent / forked-child / HMAC separation remains required and is not weakened.
Audit path policy MUST normalize both Python str and bytes path arguments before policy comparison.
Any path-like value surfaced by CPython audit events MUST be evaluated after deterministic normalized byte representation; unsupported path representations MUST fail closed.
Candidate direct access to /proc, /sys, /dev/mem, /dev/kmem, process maps, process memory, and equivalent native-memory surfaces MUST fail closed.
The prohibition MUST apply consistently to builtins.open, os.open/posix.open, _io.FileIO, and any other reachable operation emitting the governed open audit event.
Both the historical Unicode /proc/self/mem attack and the R14 bytes-path /proc/self/mem attack MUST be mandatory regressions.
Regression evidence MUST distinguish policy rejection at the intended operation from unrelated import/syntax/harness failure.
No authenticated native observation may be emitted after a forbidden path or process-memory operation is attempted.
Exact native observer source identity, compiled binary identity, compiler identity, CPython home/program identity, candidate commit/tree, run/round, and regression evidence digests MUST remain bound.
Candidate-side unittest/test labels/exit zero/stdout remain NON_AUTHORITATIVE_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY.
